title: Taylor Farms Called White House to Try to Delay Cyclospora Recall
summary: Taylor Farms, a major food supplier, contacted the White House to attempt delaying a Cyclospora-related food recall, raising concerns about corporate influence on food safety regulations and public health oversight.
problem_solved: This is a news report about a food safety incident and corporate-government interaction, not a technical solution.
why_valuable: It exposes potential corporate interference in food safety enforcement and highlights the importance of regulatory independence in protecting public health.
